intended_behavior: Modify this function to check the CLI flags `--gpt3only` and `--gpt4only` and update the `fast_llm_model` configuration via `Config.set_fast_llm_model` accordingly. When no flags are present, default to GPT-4 by setting `fast_llm_model` to "gpt-4". This update solves the issue of always defaulting to GPT-3.5 and respects user preferences.
Update the method to accept the currently configured GPT model (via config) and pass it explicitly to `chat_with_ai`, removing the hardcoded use of GPT-3.5 to enable flexible model selection.

Modify this function to accept the model name as a parameter and use it for the chat completion request instead of relying on the fixed config attribute `fast_llm_model`. This change ensures the model used matches the user’s choice or default.

Confirm that this setter properly updates the configuration’s fast LLM model value throughout the application to reflect CLI flags or environment variable changes, enabling consistent GPT model usage.
